# Plugin discovery shows installed capabilities and availability

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. List installed Plugins

SDK `GET /plugins` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "availability": "available",
      "capabilities": [
        "elevation.lookup"
      ],
      "id": "elevation",
      "release": "1.0.0"
    }
  ]
}
```

## 2. Read the Plugin directly

direct `GET /plugins/elevation` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "availability": "available",
  "capabilities": [
    "elevation.lookup"
  ],
  "id": "elevation",
  "release": "1.0.0"
}
```

SDK `GET /plugins` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "availability": "available",
      "capabilities": [
        "elevation.lookup"
      ],
      "id": "elevation",
      "release": "1.0.0"
    }
  ]
}
```

## 3. An unknown Plugin is not found

SDK `GET /plugins/missing` with <operator key>

→ **404**
```json
{
  "code": "not_found",
  "message": "Plugin not found."
}
```
